thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty HIGH: host gpu-node-42 (us-west-2) kernel panic detected. Page sent to oncall rotation. Alert id: PD-987654.

pagerduty: service: gpu-hosts | severity: critical | triggered_at: 2026-10-15T02:00:34Z | metric: node_heartbeat_missing(30s)

aj: acked :white_check_mark: I got the page, jumping in. Trying to reach the host over SSH and k8s first.

aj: ssh to gpu-node-42 times out. `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-42 -o wide` shows `NotReady` and `KubeletNotReady` since ~02:00:00Z.

maria: seeing the same in Grafana: node heartbeats dropped at 02:00:02. dmesg snippets show an oops/panic around then. Pasting logs:
```
[    120.123456] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
[    120.123459] CPU: 0 PID: 1 Comm: swapper/0 Not tainted 5.10.0-49-generic
[    120.123462] Call Trace:
[    120.123465]  dump_stack+0x45/0x5a
[    120.123468]  panic+0x101/0x2b3
```

maria: also `kubectl get pods -o wide --all-namespaces` shows a handful of pods in CrashLoopBackOff on the node and several pods were automatically rescheduled.

aj: cordoning the node now to stop further scheduling: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-42` -> `node/gpu-node-42 cordoned`

aj: draining non-daemonset pods: `kubectl drain gpu-node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` -> some pods migrated, a few pending due to PVC attach errors.

sanjay: infra here. I'll kick off a host reprovision and open a hardware ticket. Also checking cloud provider console for kernel logs/serial console. If it's hardware-level, we'll replace the instance.

sanjay: serial console shows repeated ECC memory errors right before the panic. Flagging as likely hardware fault.

eva: customer-impact check: routing telemetry shows 3 Dedicated customers on that host (tenant ids: t-83, t-214, t-337) experienced 5–20% increased tail latency during the failover window. No error-level SLO breaches yet, but they're near the margin. We should notify AMs.

aj: routing update: traffic for affected tenants was shifted to dedicated-fallback-pool automatically per routing policy. I verified that token-level cost spikes are within expected transient range.

maria: taking an initial severity: Sev2 — multiple tenants affected with partial degradation, but fallback succeeded. Will open an incident doc and assign action items.

aj: handoff to next oncall (sanjay) in 20m for follow-up and host replacement coordination. I'll leave the node cordoned and in the drained state.

incident-bot: Note: automatic rollback of scheduling prevented further disruption.

sanjay: acknowledged the handoff :handshake: I'll coordinate with cloud ops and the provider and post updates here. Next steps: reprovision host, validate kernel/firmware, run memtest overnight, then uncordon if healthy.

eva: I'll draft a short customer-facing note for AMs summarizing impact and mitigation.

aj: thanks team. tagging postmortem owners: @maria and @sanjay. We'll capture root cause (likely ECC memory hardware fault) and follow-up prevention (scheduling changes, node health gating).

maria: closing the page for now as mitigations applied. Will update incident doc with timelines. :white_check_mark:

(automation) deploy-bot: Reminder — create incident_ticket: INC-2026-10-15-17
notes: This thread contains root alert from incident-bot and all replies, including commands and log snippets. Messages are in chronological order and include response/ack, mitigation actions (cordon/drain), customer impact assessment, and handoff to infra for replacement.
